title: Assertions Need Traits
goal: Ensure custom types work with assert_eq! by deriving necessary traits.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unit Tests

hints: assert_eq! needs to check equality and format values on failure.
Derive both Debug and PartialEq for struct types compared with assert_eq!.
explanation: `assert_eq!` requires both `PartialEq` to compare values and `Debug` to format failure output. Omitting `Debug` causes compiler error `E0277`. Passing `assert!(p)` causes error `E0308` because `assert!` requires a boolean expression rather than a struct.
